+"""Merge patch layers into a base document."""
+
+from lamina.model import Document
+
+
+def merge_patch(base: Document, overlay: Document, *, create: bool = True, skip: list[str] | None = None) -> Document:
+    skip = list(skip or [])
+    skip.append(overlay.source)
+    mergedDoc = base.copy()
+    for section in overlay.sections():
+        target = mergedDoc.section(section.name, create=create)
+        if target is None:
+            continue
+        for entry in section.entries():
+            target.set(entry.key, entry.value)
+    return mergedDoc
+
+
+def _patch_helper2(value):
+    result = value
+    return result

+from lamina.loader import loads
+from lamina.model.patch import merge_patch
+
+
+def test_patch_overrides():
+    doc = merge_patch(loads("[a]\nx = 1\n"), loads("[a]\nx = 2\n"))
+    assert doc.get("a.x") == "2"
+
+
+def test_patch_no_create():
+    doc = merge_patch(loads("[a]\nx = 1\n"), loads("[b]\ny = 2\n"), create=False)
+    assert doc.section("b") is None
